data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 8.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2014: GBP 9.5m) arising predominantly from fire and other damage to property.

named_events.event_name: Medical isotope plant loss, South Africa
named_events.loss_description: The claim was settled at GBP 1.7m.
An additional loss was experienced at a fuel fabrication plant in the UK, which cost the Syndicate GBP 1.5m.

named_events.event_name: Possible material damage loss, China (claim withdrawn)
named_events.loss_description: The reserve established of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China, was not required and the claim was withdrawn.
One following a fire in France and the other as a result of dust contamination in a fuel plant in the Netherlands. The total reserve for these two claims is GBP 2.4m.

named_events.event_name: Dust contamination in a fuel plant, Netherlands (2015 claim)
named_events.loss_description: One following a fire in France and the other as a result of dust contamination in a fuel plant in the Netherlands. The total reserve for these two claims is GBP 2.4m.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a prior-year release of GBP 8.7m in 2015, primarily driven by favourable development on property business (notably fire and other damage to property). Opening claims outstanding (prior year comparative) were GBP 35.195m and the release represents a significant improvement (approx. 24.7% of opening reserves). A number of specific smaller claims (including 2013 medical isotope and fuel fabrication plant losses) and two 2015 non-power claims (fire in France and dust contamination in the Netherlands) are discussed in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: released GBP 8.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2014: GBP 9.5m) arising predominantly from fire and other damage to property.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the Balance Sheet prior-year comparative (claims outstanding GBP 35,195k). Prior-year movement taken from Note 4 narrative 'released GBP 8.7m of technical reserves' - the note does not explicitly label this as gross vs net; it is reported as a technical reserves movement and is treated here as a gross movement per the Movement in prior year's provision note. A net claims development triangle is present in the notes (labelled 'Estimate of net claims incurred'); the triangle is net rather than gross so was not used as the primary source for gross prior-year movement. Some named incidents are described in prose with combined amounts (e.g. two 2015 non-power claims totalling GBP 2.4m) and some specific amounts (e.g. GBP 1.7m, GBP 1.5m, GBP 1.4m) originate from the Underwriting Performance discussion. Claims development table in the accounts appears to be net and expressed in thousands; extraction of the full gross triangle was not possible from the scanned images provided, so the triangle provided below is partial and net.
